## Code Review Findings Summary

### Standards Axis
- **TypeScript & Build Architecture**: Strict types enabled, NodeNext module resolution with `.js` import specifiers, zero compilation errors with `tsc --noEmit`, clean production bundle and DTS generation with `tsup`.
- **Modular Boundaries**: Clean separation of responsibilities between stack detection (`src/lib/detector.ts`), fleet installation (`src/lib/installer.ts`), CLI orchestration (`src/commands/init.ts`), and command definitions (`src/index.ts`).
- **Error Handling**: Safe filesystem utilities (`readFileSafe`, `fileExists`, safe JSON parsing) prevent unhandled errors during stack discovery.

### Spec Axis (Issue #4 Deliverables Audit)
- **Common Stack Detectors**: Detects Node.js/TypeScript/JavaScript (Next.js, React, Remix, Astro, Vue, Nuxt, SvelteKit, Express, Fastify, NestJS, Koa, Hono), Python (FastAPI, Django, Flask, pytest, ruff, flake8, mypy, pyright), Go (Gin, Echo, Chi, Fiber, go test, golangci-lint), and Rust (Axum, Actix Web, Rocket, Tokio, cargo test, cargo clippy, cargo check).
- **Dynamic AGENTS.md Template Rendering**: `renderAgentsTemplate` accurately populates tech stack metadata and injects tailored commands into `## Development Workflows`.
- **Interactive Prompt Overrides**: Interactive questionnaire supported in interactive TTY sessions with CLI flag overrides and `--no-interactive` support for headless CI.
- **Unit & Integration Test Coverage**: Added comprehensive test suites in `tests/detector.test.ts`, `tests/init.test.ts`, and updated `tests/installer.test.ts`.

### Security Pass
- Static file inspection only; zero dynamic command execution or script injection risks.
- Path operations use static literals safely joined via `path.join`.
- Safe file reads restrict inspection to project manifests and configs.

### Findings Breakdown
- **Blocking**: None.
- **Non-blocking**: Minor mechanical polish on literal function replacers in `renderAgentsTemplate` and FastAPI `devCmd` prefixing with Poetry, applied directly to `main` post-merge.
